passives.name: Nimble Escape
passives.description: The nekker can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

passives.name: Pack Tactics
passives.description: The nekker has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the nekker's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

passives.name: Fear Of Fire
passives.description: If the nekker takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn. Additionally, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:  3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock Throw
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
